metadata.title: All cpu allocations after calling _make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor on a cuda tensor are in pinned memory

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



After some quantization operations are called on cuda tensors (in particular, _make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor, maybe some others) all subsequent cpu allocations are using pinned memory

trigger_conditions.pattern: Hidden State Leakage Across Tensor Operations
trigger_conditions.condition: Perform a tensor operation that changes internal runtime state, followed by an unrelated tensor operation, and detect unexpected behavior caused by leaked state.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Call torch._make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor on a CUDA integer tensor, then allocate a CPU tensor and check is_pinned(); the CPU allocation incorrectly becomes pinned memory.

failure_behavior.description: Call torch._make_per_tensor_quantized_tensor on a CUDA integer tensor, then allocate a CPU tensor and check is_pinned(); the CPU allocation incorrectly becomes pinned memory.
